description: This source file contains a Roslyn analyzer for C# code that detects attribute ID clashes within class, struct, record, or record struct declarations in the Orleans.Analyzers namespace. It checks for duplicate attribute arguments within annotated types and reports diagnostics for each duplicate ID found.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A DiagnosticAnalyzer that detects ID clashes in attributes within specific type declarations in C# code.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, enabling concurrency and configuring code analysis types, and registers syntax node actions for various declaration kinds.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes a syntax node representing a type declaration to find duplicate attribute ID arguments and reports diagnostics for clashes.
